functionalRequirement: The system shall provide a calendar view of available appointment slots for each healthcare provider

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must display all available appointment slots for each healthcare provider, including accurate start and end times, for 100% of specified use cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to provide a comprehensive view of appointment slots, necessitating full coverage of these core functional aspects.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must ensure that the calendar view accurately reflects the availability of each healthcare provider, with no more than 1% discrepancy from the actual availability.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for precise and correct representation of appointment slots based on provider availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must load the calendar view of available appointment slots within 2 seconds for up to 100 concurrent requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time access to appointment slots, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 20 MB of memory to render the calendar view for a single request.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for scalability, given the FR’s focus on handling multiple providers and appointment slots.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide an intuitive interface for navigating the calendar view, with clear and consistent labeling of appointment slots and provider information.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires interaction with appointment slots, which should be easy to operate for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to display the calendar view of appointment slots for 99.9% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to appointment slots, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must protect patient data associated with appointment slots using HIPAA-compliant encryption and access controls.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves accessing sensitive patient data, which requires robust protection.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to search for properties based on specific criteria such as location, area, and number of bedrooms

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must allow users to search for properties using all specified criteria (location, area, number of bedrooms), with results accurately reflecting the search parameters for 100% of valid inputs.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to provide a comprehensive search functionality, necessitating full coverage of these core functional aspects.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must ensure that search results accurately match the specified criteria, with no more than 2% discrepancy from the expected results.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for precise and correct representation of search results based on user input.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must return search results within 1.5 seconds for up to 500 concurrent requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time access to property listings, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 30 MB of memory to process search requests for a single query.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for scalability, given the FR’s focus on handling multiple users and search queries.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Appropriateness Recognizability: The system must provide clear and concise search results, with relevant property information (e.g., location, area, number of bedrooms) prominently displayed.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires interaction with search results, which should be easy to understand and recognize for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The system must provide an intuitive search interface, with minimal user guidance required to perform a search using all available criteria.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction with the search functionality, which should be easy to learn and use.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must be able to recover from search query errors or invalid inputs, providing meaningful error messages and suggestions for correction.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes robust handling of user input, necessitating fault tolerance and error recovery mechanisms.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must protect property listings and search results from unauthorized modifications or tampering, using secure data storage and transmission protocols.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves accessing sensitive property data, which requires robust protection against unauthorized access or modification.
